A '''stormtrooper''' of [[Joker Squad]] explored the ruins of the [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]] with at least four other Jokers in [[137 ABY]]. Along with [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Anson Trask]], the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] discovered the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Shado Vao]] in the temple's sub-basement. Vao used a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] on them, however, and they reported a fruitless search to their superiors. [[Darth Stryfe]] ordered an [[Destruction of Ossus Jedi Academy|orbital bombardment]] anyway.

==Behind the scenes==
Five [[Trooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] in total are shown exploring the ruins in the [[Legacy (2006) 17|seventeenth issue]] of ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]''. One issue [[Legacy (2006) 16|previously]], three are shown, with one of them going unnamed. It is possible that said unnamed trooper is the character described in this article.
